(It can include appointments where were never checked in, even if the appointment date is in the past. It is up to a practice to cancel appointments as a no show when appropriate to do so.)  o=open. 2=checked in. 3=checked out. 4=charge entered (i.e. a past appointment).

fields.name: appointmentstatus
fields.description: The athenaNet appointment status. There are several possible statuses.  x=cancelled. f=filled. (It can include appointments where were never checked in, even if the appointment date is in the past. It is up to a practice to cancel appointments as a no show when appropriate to do so.)  o=open. 2=checked in. 3=checked out. 4=charge entered (i.e. a past appointment).

fields.name: appointmenttype
fields.description: The practice-friendly (not patient friendly) name for this appointment type. Note that this may not be the same as the booked appointment because of "generic" slots.

fields.name: appointmenttypeid
fields.description: This is the ID for the appointment type. Note that this may not be the same as the booked appointment because of "generic" slots.

fields.name: cancelledby

fields.name: cancelleddatetime

fields.name: cancelreasonnoshow
fields.description: If the appointment was cancelled, if the cancel reason is marked as a no show reason.

fields.name: cancelreasonslotavailable
fields.description: If the appointment was cancelled, if the cancel reason is marked as a slot available reason.

fields.name: chargeentrynotrequired
fields.description: This field will tell if an appointment has been marked as not requiring change entry.

fields.name: chargeentrynotrequiredreason
fields.description: This field will give the reason that an appointment has been marked as not requiring charge entry.

fields.name: claims[].billedservicedate
fields.description: The billed date of service.

fields.name: claims[].chargeamount
fields.description: The total amount billed for all services from this claim.

fields.name: claims[].claimcreateddate
fields.description: The date the claim was created.

fields.name: claims[].claimid
fields.description: athenaNet's internal ID for this claim, specific to the practice.

fields.name: claims[].diagnoses
fields.description: Diagnoses is an array of all diagnoses. Each entry in the array is a hash with several fields. /ccda is a better clinical representation. These fields are:

fields.name: diagnoses[].deleteddiagnosis
fields.description: In certain cases, diagnoses may be added and then removed from a particular claim.  In normal circumstances, this will be false.  However, if a diagnosis was removed, this will be true.

fields.name: diagnoses[].diagnosiscategory
fields.description: The category for this diagnosis.

fields.name: diagnoses[].diagnosiscodeset
fields.description: Either ICD9 or ICD10.

fields.name: diagnoses[].diagnosisdescription
fields.description: A description of this diagnosis.

fields.name: diagnoses[].diagnosisid
fields.description: A unique ID related to this diagnosis.

fields.name: diagnoses[].diagnosisrawcode
fields.description: The raw ICD-9 code.  This will migrate to ICD-10 in the future.

fields.name: claims[].patientpayer
fields.description: The status and notes of a responsible payer.  This payer is the patient.

fields.name: claims[].primaryinsurancepayer
fields.description: The status and notes of a responsible payer.  This payer is the primary insurace.

fields.name: claims[].procedures
fields.description: Procedures is an array of all procedures. /ccda is a better clinical representation. These fields are:

fields.name: procedures[].allowableamount
fields.description: The total amount expected from payer for all services from this procedure.

fields.name: procedures[].allowablemax
fields.description: The maximum amount expected from payer for all services from this procedure.

fields.name: procedures[].allowablemin
fields.description: The minimum amount expected from payer for all services from this procedure.

fields.name: procedures[].chargeamount
fields.description: The amount charged for this procedure.

fields.name: procedures[].procedurecategory
fields.description: The category name associated with this procedure.

fields.name: procedures[].procedurecode
fields.description: The CPT code associated with this procedure.

fields.name: procedures[].proceduredescription
fields.description: A description of this procedure.

fields.name: procedures[].transactionid
fields.description: The ID of the last transaction associated with the claim.

fields.name: claims[].referringproviderid
fields.description: The referring provider ID for this claim.  See /referringproviders.  This is not the same as the ID from the /providers call.

fields.name: claims[].secondaryinsurancepayer
fields.description: The status and notes of a responsible payer.  This payer is the secondary insurace.

fields.name: claims[].transactiondetails
fields.description: A hash of ids ("transactionid") to amounts; these should sum to the chargeamount. Please note that this has been deprecated in lieu of the data being available in the procedures section.

fields.name: claims[].transactionid
fields.description: A unique ID for the primary transaction this claim represents.  May be useful for debugging.

description: Appointment reminders are for prompting the practice to schedule future or follow-up appointments for its patients. API users can create, update, retrieve, and delete appointment reminders. Within athenaOne, appointment reminders are referenced as "Appointment Ticklers." Retrieving and Creating Appointment Reminders API users can retrieve all appointment reminders from specific departments within a practice, or a single patient. Only one appointment reminder can be created per call in athenaOne.

description: If you are a patient looking to make a payment,  please click here to Make a Payment  or contact your provider. A prepayment plan allows a user to make a payment for a procedure in advance of the claim being generated. After the claim is created and adjudicated, prepayment money is moved from the plan to pay the claim. The  retrieve prepayment plans  endpoint allows a user to retrieve all relevant details of a patient's prepayment plan(s).
